To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the electroweak theory based on the nonlinearly realized gauge group SU( 2)⊗ U( 1) is a consistent quantum field theory.

the nonlinear electroweak gauge model based on the SU(2) × U(1) nonlinearly realized gauge group can be consistently constructed at the tree level, the one-loop renormalization of this model is feasible, the decoupling theorem holds true, and the model can be renormalized in the Landau gauge.

1) we have proven that the Weak Power Counting holds for the nonlinearly realized electroweak gauge model; 2) we have constructed the counterterms for one-loop renormalization; 3) we have proven the decoupling theorem for the nonlinearly realizations of the electroweak theory; 4) we have identified the physical photon and Z fields.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a nonlinearly realized electroweak theory in the Landau gauge.

the construction of an effective theory of the electroweak interactions in the presence of nonlinearly realized symmetries, with the aim of providing a framework where to formulate the renormalization program in a gauge-invariant and gauge-dependent way.
the construction of an SU(2)⊗U(1) model based on the non-linear realization of the gauge symmetry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the present work represents a complete functional formulation of a model based on a non-linear realization of the gauge symmetries, with a clear identification of the physical content and the unphysical modes.
, in the present model, the gauge symmetry is realized non-linearly and the gauge bosons are physical, while the Goldstone bosons are unphysical.
the SU(2)⊗U(1) electroweak theory based on the nonlinear realization of the SU(2)xU(1) gauge group is fully renormalizable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nonlinearly realized SU(2)U(1) electroweak theory, when formulated in terms of the physical fields, is a well defined perturbative quantum field theory, with a finite set of counterterms.

we have provided a complete set of functional equations for the electroweak theory, including the Landau Gauge identity, that is necessary for the construction of a renormalizable theory in a manifestly covariant form.
the electroweak theory is a renormalizable theory in the Landau gauge, and that the physical fields are the same of the Standard Model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nonlinearly realized electroweak theory is a viable alternative to the Standard Model, which can be used for the construction of a renormalizable theory.
the electroweak sector can be formulated as a local functional of the physical fields.
the functional approach is the most appropriate to handle the nonlinearly realized electroweak models.
